description: iter7 target settings retained + from_head focal loss rebalanced: α 0.25→0.75, γ 2.0→3.0. Ships unchanged (iter8 rejected).

accuracy.comment: acc dropped because pred_pos_rate rose to match gt=0.127

conclusion: BREAKTHROUGH. iter9 achieved 5/100 win rate — the first non-zero win rate for imitation/case1 in the Phase 2 experiment (baseline/iter6/iter7/iter8 all 0/100). The hypothesis that from_head gating was the real tactical bottleneck is validated: iter7 proved target-head class weighting works at val-level but did not translate to wins, while iter9 flipped focal α from 0.25 (negatives) to 0.75 (positives) and lifted the sigmoid distribution so the agent actually fires on the turns it should. Target improvements from iter7 are preserved in iter9 (macro_f1 0.295 vs iter6 0.279).
decision: Adopt iter9 as the new Phase-2 canonical baseline. Next steps: (a) make iter9 the default weights.pt path; (b) optionally retry ships (iter10) now that from+target are fixed — previously iter8 failed because weak ships class weights couldn't overcome bucket-3 majority, but the calibration context is now different; (c) proceed to Phase 2 integration eval.
